name: plan_removal
summary: Price a removal without doing it: the dry run of remove_cables, remove_pipes or remove_chutes (kind) for ids, cells or a whole network. Changes nothing, ever. Read only.

help.text: Returns the remove tools' own report: removals with their refunds, materials.refund (the total), would_split, networks_before and networks_after, problems and warnings. With no player, no from_id and refund_to source, no_local_player is a warning here: the refund is priced, and a real run would need from_id. Burnt cables price at nothing back.
help.keys: tool, status, job_id, grade, ready, problems [{code, message, reference_id, at}], warnings [{code, message, reference_id, at}], cells_total, placed, changed, kept, removed_count, air_cells, cells [{at, action, prefab_name, rotation_deg, shape, ends, cost, refund, ...}], removals [{reference_id, prefab_name, at, network_id, refund, assumed}], materials {from, needed, refund_enabled, refund, refund_plan}, networks_before, networks_after [{index, networks_before, new_pieces, device_count, devices, guard}], would_bridge [{kind, networks, device, ports, allowed}], would_split [{network_id, parts, cut_ports, allowed, components, root, cut_off}], links {count_before, count_after, added, lost, added_count, ...}, notes, resolved_networks.

reference_ids.description: Pieces to price; or give waypoints, cells or network_id.

items.description: [x, y, z] or {x, y, z} in metres.

waypoints.description: The pieces in every cell along these straight lines.

items.description: [x, y, z] or {x, y, z} in metres.

reference_id.description: A device or piece on the network.

network_id.description: Every piece of this network, up to 1024 (see networks).

root.description: The device the network is fed from, for would_split's cut_off. Default every supplier on it.

allow_split.description: Report would_split as allowed. Default false.

include_links.description: true: list every added and lost link; default counts only.

include_notes.description: true: include notes, the tool's fixed explanations. Default false.
